summary: Completed E2E testing of EcoAndes clone. Backend: 100% pass rate on all required endpoints (174 products, pricing, VAT, hero, categories, auth, shipping, coupons). Frontend: Shop and Product Detail pages work correctly with all features (category filters, search, format dropdown, add to cart, IVA pricing). Home page experienced intermittent 502 gateway error (Cloudflare issue, resolved on retry). Minor frontend bug: calling /api/categories instead of /api/products/categories (404 error, non-blocking).

integration_issues.issue: Frontend calls /api/categories endpoint which returns 404. Should call /api/products/categories instead
integration_issues.impact: Non-blocking - categories still load via correct endpoint elsewhere

intermittent_issues.issue: Intermittent 502 Bad Gateway error on initial load
intermittent_issues.resolution: Resolved on retry - not a code issue
